def knob(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=20 and n['boundary'][0][0]<40:
            out.append((n['color'],n['pixels'],n['boundary'][0],n['boundary'][-1]))
    bar=[n['pixels'] for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>20]
    return out,bar

print('after:', knob(current_frame))
